people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, everyone who commits sin is the bondservant of sin.
translations.bsb: Jesus replied, “Truly, truly, I tell you, everyone who sins is a slave to sin.
translations.kjv: Jesus answered them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whosoever committeth sin is the servant of sin.
translations.asv: Jesus answered them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Every one that committeth sin is the bondservant of sin.
